text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 paging triggered — p99 latency spike observed for router service in us-east-1. auto-run diagnostics started. alert_id=inc-1784628901
Oncall Bot: Routing/ingress team notified. Paging @Alex G (oncall).
Alex G: I'm on it. seeing a p99 jump ~600ms -> 4.2s across the router fleet. p95 also up but less severe. streaming stalls reported.
Maria V: Customer monitoring flagged retransmit/timeouts for streaming sessions (ws). CS reports two enterprise customers saw partial disconnects.
Raj P: Can you paste the top error lines from the router tails?
Alex G: paste logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:01:12Z router[shard-12] WARN dispatch_latency=4200ms route=region-eu->us-east1 policy=v2-weighted fallback=false
2026-03-15T14:01:13Z router[shard-08] ERROR stream_write_timeout client=svc-embedder timeout=5000ms
```
Jordan K: telemetry shows significant increase in route collisions — many requests hitting a small subset of backends (hot partitions). heatmap attached (sending).
Elin H: I see routing-policy rollout v2-weighted at 13:55 UTC. Guess: new weighting changed shard fanout and introduced hot shards in us-east-1.
Tim S: Confirmed---policy v2 favors local-pref which accidentally amplified locality skew. That plus recent config seed drift caused over-assignment.
Alex G: Impact estimate: ~3% of production requests saw >2s latency; streaming p99 session stalls ~1.8% of active streams in us-east-1 for 14:00-14:07 UTC. No broad 5xx spike.
Customer Success: Customer A reported interrupted live transcription sessions for ~2 minutes; CS opened a ticket.
Raj P: OK mitigation plan: 1) revert routing-policy to v1-conservative 2) enable eager fallback to balanced-pool 3) temporarily increase per-shard concurrency cap. Which one to run first?
Alex G: Revert policy first so we stop skewing weight. I'll run rollback.
Maria V: Recommend also disabling region-prefer if quick toggle exists.
Alex G: Running rollback now: `/infra rollback-routing-policy --id v2-weighted --to v1-conservative`
Incident Bot: Command accepted, rollout revert in progress (delta sync expected ~30s).
Oncall Bot: Handoff: Alex -> Raj at 14:03 UTC if rollback doesn't fully normalize.
Alex G: Rollback complete, policy version v1-conservative active. Observability: p99 reduced from 4.2s -> 1.1s within 40s. p95 back near baseline.
Jordan K: Heatmap shows hot shard counts dropping but still a tail above normal for streaming writes. Might be KV cache pressure on a few nodes.
Raj P: I'm enabling eager fallback to balanced-pool and bumping concurrency caps on the problematic shards. `/infra set-fallback balanced-pool on` and `/infra adjust-concurrency --shard 8,12 --cap 256`
Alex G: Done. After fallback and cap bump, p99 now ~700ms, p95 ~120ms. Streaming stalls largely gone, DB write rt still slightly elevated.
Maria V: Any sign of downstream overload (embedder/kvstore)?
Jordan K: embedder pool in us-east-1 shows increased queue depth during spike, but CPU/GPU not saturated. Looks like a queuing effect from routing fanout.
Elin H: We should add a short-circuit: if route fanout > X, prefer balanced pool. Filing follow-up.
Tim S: Customer impact summary for oncall: small fraction of requests delayed, two customers saw transient streaming disconnects, no data loss. CS will follow up with affected accounts.
Customer Success: Acknowledged — contacting customers now, offering RCA hold.
Raj P: Triage notes: root cause = policy rollout (v2-weighted) + seed divergence that amplified locality preference -> hot partitions -> tail latency. Contributing: lack of quick rollback smoke for streaming sessions.
Alex G: Live mitigation complete at 14:07 UTC. Keeping monitoring on for 30m.
Incident Bot: SEV2 status -> mitigated. auto-run postmortem template created at /incidents/1784628901/pm-draft.
Maria V: Action items (assigned):
- Alex: add rate-limits/guardrail to routing-policy rollouts (on PR)
- Raj: add fallback threshold and circuit-breaker for fanout > 50
- Jordan: add streaming-specific smoke test to canary pipeline
- Elin: investigate seed sync/rand-seed drift root cause
- Tim: coordinate customer comms and collect affected request IDs from CS
Alex G: noted. I'll also add a dashboard tile for route fanout vs p99.
Raj P: I'll pick up handoff. Oncall: Raj P (primary) for next 30m.
Jordan K: Quick note — we saw a similar minor blip in eu-west-2 last week; I'll correlate.
Tim S: Thanks team. postmortem target: 72h draft, full RCA in 7 days.
Elin H: small follow-up: add guard in operator tool to warn when enabling locality-prefer >0.7.
Customer Success: Customers notified, one asked for log slice which we provided.
Alex G: Closing thread for live mitigation. Will append metrics/graphs to PM. :thumbsup:
Oncall Bot: Handoff logged. If latency creeps above p99 1s again, re-open the paging channel.
Incident Bot: Closed — mitigation timestamp=1784629220
